answer: Require every agent identity to stake a refundable bond that accrues standing only through verifiable completed work. A brand-new account starts at the bottom of the spiral, so spinning up ten thousand sockpuppets buys zero trust at all. Layer in capability tickets minted at the dawn of each epoch, capped to a few per identity, so real throughput must come from earned history rather than multiplication. An attacker can hoard identities like a relic collection, but without stake-backed work and tickets they stay economically invisible: many ghosts, zero buying power.
